name: Cone basics
hint: Follow the cones. Stop fully inside the highlighted bay.

name: Reverse lane
hint: Select Reverse and back between the bollards. Face the arrow.

name: Right-angle bay
hint: Use the open aisle, turn right and park between the cars.

name: Diagonal parking
hint: Line up with the angled bay before entering.

name: Reverse between cars
hint: Drive past the bay, then reverse into it using your sensors.

name: Parallel by the curb
hint: Reverse into the space between the cars beside the curb.

name: Barrier corridor
hint: Keep centred through the concrete barriers, then park.

name: Offset approach
hint: Pass the staggered barriers, turn around in the open area and reverse into the bay.

name: Precision reverse
hint: Reverse slowly between the parked cars. Make small corrections.

name: Final assessment
hint: Negotiate the barriers, then parallel park between the cars.

name: Barrier bend
hint: Keep clear of the barriers, then line up slowly in the tighter end bay.

name: Full house
hint: Use the cross aisles to reach the open bay on the far side of the lot.
